title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.01][runtime] Make dynamic-agent removal crash-consistent
goal: Prove dynamic-agent removal converges across all interruption boundaries.
summary: Plan deterministic failure injection, restart reconciliation, focused Runtime regression and review proof.
required_outcome: Every injected persistence failure reopens to one coherent lifecycle state without resurrection or checkpoint loss.
repo_inputs: Issue757 and scoped Runtime persistence/test surfaces.
target_files_surfaces: adl-runtime-kernel/src/control.rs; adl-runtime-kernel/src/agent_partial_checkpoint.rs; focused tests and issue757 evidence.
non_goals: No broad full-repository validation unless the focused owner lane exposes coupling.
validation_plan: Boundary failure-injection tests; restart/reopen convergence tests; focused Runtime owner lane; format and diff checks; independent review.
dependencies: Implementation must preserve authoritative tombstone and coherent roster/orientation truth.
failure_policy: Fail on any partial state that resurrects a tombstoned agent, loses a recoverable resident checkpoint, reports failed removal with unrecoverable identity, or leaves projections inconsistent.
